theorem erdos_273 : ∃ c : StrictCoveringSystem ℤ, ∀ i, ∃ (p : ℕ), p.Prime ∧ 5 ≤ p ∧
    c.moduli i = Ideal.span {↑(p - 1)}
doc: Is there a covering system all of whose moduli are of the form $p-1$ for some primes $p \geq 5$?
